avoid_supplements.name: Warfarin (if concurrent use)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Amoxicillin may potentiate warfarin effect by reducing vitamin K-producing gut flora and displacing protein binding
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor INR closely; coordinate with prescriber for dose adjustments if concurrent use necessary

avoid_supplements.name: Oral contraceptives
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Amoxicillin reduces enterohepatic recirculation of ethinylestradiol by disrupting gut flora, potentially decreasing contraceptive efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Use backup contraception during antibiotic course and for 7 days after completion

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics (Lactobacillus, Bifidobacterium)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Amoxicillin destroys beneficial gut bacteria; probiotics may help restore microbiota balance
caution_supplements.action: May administer probiotics 2+ hours apart from amoxicillin dosing; consider after antibiotic course completion

caution_supplements.name: Methotrexate
caution_supplements.mechanism: Amoxicillin may reduce renal clearance of methotrexate, increasing toxicity risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor renal function and methotrexate levels if concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay gastric absorption of amoxicillin, though clinical significance is minimal
caution_foods.action: Take amoxicillin on an empty stomach (1 hour before or 2 hours after meals) for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Dairy products with calcium
caution_foods.mechanism: Calcium may form chelate complexes, minimally reducing amoxicillin absorption
caution_foods.action: Separate administration by 2 hours if taking calcium supplements or large dairy servings

monitoring_notes: Monitor for allergic reactions, GI disturbances (diarrhea/C. difficile risk), and drug-drug interactions with anticoagulants or immunosuppressants. Assess baseline renal function as amoxicillin is renally eliminated; adjust dosing in severe renal impairment.
